title: fix(iteration): show the real total in list header
description:
## Description

`glab iteration list` passed `len(iterations)` as both the count and the total
in its header, so the total was always the size of the current page. This is
the same bug !3991 fixed for `label list`, and was pointed out in its review.

This keeps the `*gitlab.Response` returned by `ListProjectIterations` and
`ListGroupIterations`, and builds the header with `utils.NewListTitle`, as
!3991 does for `label list`:

- The total comes from `resp.TotalItems`.
- When the response carries no total, the header omits "of N" instead of
  repeating the page count.
- An empty list prints `No iterations available on ...`.
- The group case sets `RepoName` to the group, like `mr list`.

The header format changes accordingly, for example
`Showing iteration 1 of 1 on OWNER/REPO.` becomes
`Showing 1 of 25 iterations on OWNER/REPO. (Page 1)`, and the group header
reads `on GROUP` instead of `for group GROUP`.

The iteration list body and the JSON output are unchanged.

## Related Issues

Resolves #8591

Follow-up to !3991 (#8573).

## How has this been tested?

- `internal/commands/iteration/list/iteration_list_test.go`:
  - Updated the expected headers of the existing cases, including the empty
    list, which now prints `No iterations available on OWNER/REPO.`
  - Added `TestIterationListHeaderTotal` with a project case and a group case
    that mock `TotalItems: 25` and expect `of 25`, and a case where the
    response has no total. All three fail on `main` with `1 of 1`.
- `go test ./internal/commands/iteration/...` and
  `go vet ./internal/commands/iteration/list/` pass.
- `golangci-lint run ./internal/commands/iteration/...` (v2.14.0, as pinned in
  `.tool-versions`) reports 0 issues, and `golangci-lint fmt --diff` reports no
  changes.
- `go run ./scripts/comment-overlap` reports 0 findings on the changed files.
- Ran a build of this branch against a self-managed GitLab 19.3.3-ee instance.
  It has no iterations, so only the empty-list header could be checked live:

  | Command | `main` | This branch |
  |---|---|---|
  | `glab iteration list` | `Showing iteration 0 of 0 on OWNER/REPO.` | `No iterations available on OWNER/REPO.` |
  | `glab iteration list -g GROUP` | `Showing iteration 0 of 0 for group GROUP.` | `No iterations available on GROUP.` |

  The `-F json` output is byte-identical to `main`.

title: Draft: feat(mcp): remove the experimental glab mcp command
description:
## Description

Removes the experimental `glab mcp` command. Users should use the [GitLab MCP Server](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/model_context_protocol/mcp_server/) instead. This is step 2 of the plan in the related issue: remove one milestone after the deprecation in !3998.

After this change, users who run `glab mcp serve` see:

```plaintext
❯ glab mcp serve

   ERROR

  Unknown command "mcp" for "glab"
```

This MR targets the !3998 branch so the diff shows only the removal. GitLab retargets it to `main` once !3998 merges.

- Deletes `internal/commands/mcp/` (the server and `glab mcp serve`) and its registration in `root.go`.
- Removes `cmdutils.AllowedValuer`, which only fed enum values into MCP tool schemas.
- Removes the `invocation_source` telemetry property (`internal/api/invocation_source.go`, `BuildInfo.InvocationSource`). Without the MCP server nothing sets it.
- Drops `github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk` and its indirect dependencies from `go.mod`.
- Drops `glab mcp serve` from two code comments and the MCP mention in `AGENTS.md`.

### Annotations are kept

The `mcpannotations` package, the annotation on every command, and the coverage test that requires one stay. The `Safe`/`Destructive` split is the read/write classification that read-only mode (#8353) plans to reuse. A follow-up can rename them to a neutral name, for example `cmdannotations.ReadOnly`, as part of that work. Comments in the two annotation tests no longer refer to the removed server.

## Related Issues

Closes #8583

## How has this been tested?

- `glab mcp serve` returns `Unknown command "mcp" for "glab"`.
- `make test-changed` passes: 4,575 tests, 8 skipped.
- `golangci-lint run --new-from-rev=origin/main ./...` reports 0 issues.
- `lefthook run pre-push` passes (build, lint, tests, generated docs and code, markdown).
